title: Welcome to the New Digital Era of SPE ITB SC!

body:
The SPE Bandung Institute of Technology Student Chapter (SPE ITB SC), under the umbrella of SPE Java Indonesia Section, has taken a bold step in elevating how student chapters communicate, collaborate, and contribute to the energy community. 

In a milestone move for the 2024/2025 term, SPE ITB SC proudly announces the soft launch of two major platforms: a newly designed official website and their first-ever digital magazine.

Both platforms reflect the chapter’s renewed identity and aspirations for the year, carrying the spirit of their chosen theme: #EclatwithPRIDE : a celebration of brilliance, excellence, and unity in every aspect of their initiatives.

A New Digital Home for SPE ITB SC

The newly launched [[speitbsc.org](http://speitbsc.org/)](http://speitbsc.org/) website offers a clean, modern, and interactive space designed to serve not only as an information center, but also a platform for engagement. Visitors can now easily access:

The latest updates and event recaps

Committee introductions and member spotlights

Interactive features for joining or collaborating

Dedicated sections for IPFEST 2025, sponsors, and more

Whether you're a student eager to explore energy topics, an alumni reconnecting with your roots, or an industry professional seeking collaboration, the website provides a welcoming and informative experience for all.

A Creative Leap: SPE ITB SC’s First Digital Magazine

Complementing the website launch, SPE ITB SC also unveils their inaugural digital magazine — a platform blending student voices, professional insights, and creative storytelling.

The magazine includes:

Personal reflections from active members

Student-driven perspectives on the energy industry

Visual recaps of events and chapter activities

Thoughtful articles on leadership, innovation, and community impact

This publication aims to document the chapter’s dynamic journey, share its unique culture, and highlight the people and ideas shaping its progress.

A Message to the Community

The soft launch of these two platforms is just the beginning of SPE ITB SC’s digital transformation. The chapter invites fellow students, alumni, professionals, and the wider SPE community to explore the new website, read the magazine, and be part of the exciting initiatives ahead.
